# `ecfr_snapshots`

**Dated eCFR snapshot observations**

One original eCFR response observed under an explicit dated selection. Titles, parts and sections retain the selection scope and publisher metadata.

**Coverage.** Sampled. Selected dated original responses only. A retained response establishes its selected source scope, not a complete historical eCFR census. *(measured 2026-10-10)*

- **Parquet file:** `ecfr_snapshots.parquet`
- **MCP `query_sql` support:** Configured; requires an available artifact.
- **Publication status:** Not established by this schema page or its measurement date.
- **Row count:** Not stated here; the MCP `describe_table` reply gives the live count under `publication`.

| Column | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `snapshot_id` | `VARCHAR` | Reader identity of the dated source selection and original body digest. |
| `snapshot_date` | `VARCHAR` | Source selection date. |
| `selected_part` | `VARCHAR` | Caller-selected CFR part, when requested. |
| `selected_section` | `VARCHAR` | Caller-selected CFR section, when requested. |
| `source_sha256` | `VARCHAR` | SHA-256 of the original selected source bytes. |
| `source_url` | `VARCHAR` | Public publisher URL identifying the selected original source. |
| `native_metadata_json` | `VARCHAR` | Publisher metadata retained as JSON. |
| `title` | `BIGINT` | Source title number. |
| `source_bytes` | `BIGINT` | Decoded original source body size in bytes. |
| `content_nodes` | `BIGINT` | Number of content nodes observed in the selected source body. |
